info.name: Datalastic Maritime Historical Zone Traffic API

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the static center point. Requires lon.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of the static center point. Requires lat.

params.name: port_uuid
params.description: Port UUID to use as the center point.

params.name: port_unlocode
params.description: Port UN/LOCODE to use as the center point.

params.name: uuid
params.description: Vessel UUID to use as a dynamic (moving) center point.

params.name: mmsi
params.description: Vessel MMSI to use as a dynamic (moving) center point.

params.name: imo
params.description: Vessel IMO number to use as a dynamic (moving) center point.

params.name: radius
params.description: Search radius in nautical miles. Maximum 50 NM.

params.name: type
params.description: Vessel type filter (for example Cargo, Tanker, Fishing).

params.name: type_specific
params.description: Vessel subtype filter (for example Crude Oil Tanker). Can be used on its own or combined with type. Use _empty_ to include or exclude vessels whose type is NULL.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Vessel types to exclude from the results.

params.name: nav_status
params.description: Numeric navigational status code to filter by.

items.docs: Returns all vessels within a radius (maximum 50 nautical miles) around either a static point - lat/lon coordinates, a port_uuid, or a port_unlocode - or a dynamic center defined by a moving vessel's uuid, mmsi, or imo. Results can be filtered by vessel type, specific subtype, exclusions, and navigational status. Deducts 1 credit per vessel found (maximum 500).
